answer: The ridge timber bond lets any keeper challenge a newcomer. A newcomer posts a $5 bond and files a timber sample stamped with a ferrous mark at the ridge. For a full day any keeper may challenge it with a matching mark from the ridge roll; a copied sample, a mark stamped twice, or timber with no work behind it splits the bond between challenger and ridge fund. One honest newcomer risks $5; faking a hundred needs a hundred samples and $500 locked.
